title: Oil prices climb 3% as market awaits US-Iran talks
description: Oil prices surged about 3% on Wednesday after a media report suggested planned talks between the United States and Iran on Friday could collapse.

title: Trump's Stark Warning to Khamenei Ahead of Iran-US Talks: 'Should be Very Worried'
description: The meeting is now set to take place in Oman, after Iran pressed for a change in both location and format. The United States had initially rejected moving the talks from Istanbul, US News, Times Now

title: Iran Confirms US Talks In Oman: “Grateful To Our Omani Brothers” - But Will Nuclear Disputes Derail Them Again?
description: Iran has confirmed that nuclear-focused talks with the United States will take place in Oman on Friday, despite deep disagreements over the agenda and rising regional tensions.

title: U.S.-Iran Talks in Oman: Nuclear Tensions on the Rise
description: The United States and Iran are set to hold talks in Oman, focusing on Tehran's nuclear program amid escalating tensions. The U.S. wants to include Iran's missile program and regional actions, while Iran prefers a focus solely on nuclear issues. The venue has shifted due to Iranian requests.

title: "US open to talks with Iran, meeting not to be seen as legitimisation of regime": Rubio
description: The United States has said it is ready to engage in talks with Iran amid escalated tension between the two countries if Tehran is willing to meet, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday (local time) emphasising that Washington does not view dialogue as a concession or legitimisation of the Iranian regime.

title: United States Brent Oil Rises As Iran Nuclear Talks Face Collapse
description: United States Brent Oil Fund LP (NYSE:BNO) is climbing on Wednesday as crude prices push higher, driven by reports that planned nuclear talks between the U.S. and Iran are on the verge of falling apart.

title: Iran says US talks are on, as Trump warns supreme leader
description: Iran said Wednesday that talks with the United States were going ahead as planned later this week, as President Donald Trump piled pressure on Tehran's supreme leader by saying he should be "very worried."Doubts have swirled about the fate of the negotiations, with a report earlier Wednesday that the talks were falling apart sending oil prices surging and increasing expectations of US military action.But Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said nuclear talks were now scheduled for Friday in Oman. Diplomats had earlier said the meeting would happen on Friday in Turkey.
